site_parameters.ell_active_i: active-slot loss probability per epoch at site i
site_parameters.ell_spare_i: spare-slot loss probability per epoch at site i
site_parameters.r_check_i: readout/occupancy-check failure probability per epoch at site i

cumulative_site_survival: S_i(n_i)=(1-ell_active_i)^(T-n_i)*(1-ell_spare_i)^n_i*(1-r_check_i)^T, where n_i is number of spare epochs assigned to site i and sum_i n_i=T.
objective: maximize minimum_i S_i, equivalently minimize maximum negative-log cumulative site risk

comparison.optimized_known_heterogeneity: enumerate all integer n_i>=0 with sum n_i=5
comparison.robust_unknown_heterogeneity: site labels are unknown/adversarial before assignment; compare worst-case permutation of a bounded risk multiset

theorem_targets: prove uniform rotation is minimax for homogeneous site parameters
test whether it remains minimax for known heterogeneous parameters
test whether uniform counts are minimax against unknown adversarial relabeling when only the multiset/bounds are known
claim_rule: rotation is a burden-equalization theorem; reliability advantage requires a declared heterogeneity information model.
